HILAO STUDIO

Apni kahani, apna editor.

  1. Character chuno

    Library se character lo ya apni PNG/JPG upload karo.

  2. Scene sajao

    Background, ratio aur position set karo. Plus se naya scene banao.

  3. Gardan hilao

    Ring Motion mein speed/movement set karo. Ring ko gardan par drag karo; Done se guides chhupao.

  4. Save aur Download

    Project browser mein save hota hai. Current scene ya poori timeline ka video export karo. Audio bhi jud sakta hai.

Yeh working 2D head/body motion editor hai. AI image/video generation, lip-sync aur walk rigs is version mein nahi hain. Koi nakli AI button nahi.
